assumptions: Column names differing only in case/whitespace are the same species and their counts were summed (G. ruber, N. incompta, G. inflata).
issues: Three taxa appeared twice under variant capitalisation/spacing; merged, giving 8 species instead of 11 columns.
summary: Normalised taxon names (lowercase, collapsed whitespace), summed duplicate columns, counted species, and computed mean pairwise Bray-Curtis on raw counts across all sample pairs.
